name: Jausenstation Zauberwinkel
kurzbeschreibung:
**Snack Stop Zauberwinkel in Wildschönau**

Discover the cozy charm of **Wildschönau** at the **Zauberwinkel**, your perfect pit stop for hearty Austrian mountain fare. Tucked away in the scenic heart of **Tirol**, this rustic spot serves up traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Speckknödel**, and fresh **Käsekrainer**—all paired with locally brewed beers and crisp **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** for dessert.

Whether you're hiking the **Zillertal Alps** or exploring the **Inntal Valley**, the **Zauberwinkel** offers a warm welcome, homemade hospitality, and a taste of **Tirol’s** finest flavors. Don’t miss their famous **Kaffee mit Schmarren**—a sweet, fluffy treat to refuel after your adventures.

Open year-round, this hidden gem is just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, making it the ideal detour for travelers craving authentic **Tiroler** comfort food. **Prost und an Guadn!**
